name: pumba-atomic-netem-campaigns
instr:
Make every selected multi-target netem action behave as one atomic campaign with a shared identity, activation boundary, duration, and target-attributed outcome. Partial preparation, activation, cancellation, or expiry must leave no campaign-owned disruption behind while preserving foreign traffic-control state. Existing single-target behavior and runtime-specific execution semantics remain compatible.

Each delay, loss, corrupt, duplicate, rate, Gilbert-Elliott loss, and state-model loss action resolves and freezes membership once, rejects duplicate identities before runtime work, prepares every target before any activation, and reports each target exactly once. Caller-owned campaign data remains immutable, and every derived request preserves its target, command, filters, interface, sidecar image, pull choice, and dry-run setting. Preparation distinguishes untouched, newly created, and already owned topology so rollback removes only campaign-owned state. Any preparation failure prevents activation and compensates successful preparations in reverse order; expiry, cancellation, and partial activation compensate every obligated target using bounded live cleanup contexts. Primary and compensation failures retain their target identities without hiding either error. Docker preserves direct and sidecar behavior, containerd preserves namespace-scoped direct and sidecar behavior through rollback, and Podman rejects all rootless mutating phases before delegation while privileged opera
